title: Jedi Levitation
caption: Jedi Levitation (V)
game_text:
USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny.
LOST: Use 3 Force to retrieve a non-{maintenance} character into hand.
lore: A Jedi can adjust the Force within and around an object, causing it to move as the Jedi wills.

notes: Non-unique (no dot). Printed base is a Lost Interrupt (slip banner reads USED OR LOST INTERRUPT). Inline icon after 'non-' is the gold spoked wheel on a gold square = the MAINTENANCE icon per the VS5 cover ICON KEY ('references a card with a maintenance cost') → {maintenance}; the wiki stub reads 'non-Episode I character', which does not match the slip. Lore corrected from scan: 'Force' is capitalized on the printed card (wiki base page has lowercase 'force'). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 (Dagobah) not legible at 350 px. Modern: V0-L-jedilevitation.gif (745) used; VB2 -pre (350) also exists on the wiki, not downloaded.
